elevate.move: Make 'the year turns as you read' the one nameable motion: on each spread entry the folio numeral rolls from the previous spread's month in a digit slot, the 12-cell month bar fills cell by cell to the same month and the rail tab slides out, all on one shared 500ms ease-out; nothing else moves except tool readouts, reduced motion shows final states.

Give the almanac a printed-matter type system: Crimson italic and small caps for every kicker and plate caption, old-style figures in folios and prices, a drop cap or run-in heading opening each month spread; mono kept only for the rail and Sample chips.
